questions: Does the chest pain worsen with deep breathing or coughing (pleuritic pain)?
Have you had any shortness of breath or low oxygen symptoms (e.g., dizziness or feeling faint) when the chest pain occurs?
Have you had any swelling or pain in one leg (especially the calf) or recent leg injury/immobility?
answers: Yes. It’s worse when I take a deep breath and when I cough—very pleuritic, sharp like a knife stroke.
Yes, I feel significant shortness of breath with the chest pain. Also, I’ve lost consciousness/did feel faint.
Yes. I have swelling in my left calf, and it hurts. I also had surgery within the last month, so I’ve been less mobile.
